mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_chat_message WHERE session_key = #{sessionKey} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_chat_message (session_key, role, content) VALUES (#{sessionKey}, #{role}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT session_key AS sessionKey, COUNT(*) AS messageCount, MIN(created_at) AS firstTime, MAX(created_at) AS lastTime, (SELECT content FROM t_chat_message t2 WHERE t2.session_key = t1.session_key AND t2.role = 'user' ORDER BY t2.id LIMIT 1) AS firstUserMessage FROM t_chat_message t1 GROUP BY session_key ORDER BY lastTime DESC
